people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
translations.bsb: Thus it will be done to you, O Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day dawns, the king of Israel will be utterly cut off.
translations.kjv: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
translations.asv: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: at daybreak shall the king of Israel be utterly cut off.
